source: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
title: R29 LLM filter: switch from hard-threshold verdict to ranking + add co-movement sign prediction
rationale: arXiv:2602.07048 (Kim et al., Feb 2026) runs the exact R29 experiment on prediction market pairs. Key finding: the LLM's primary contribution is LOSS REDUCTION (avg loss -46.5%), not win rate improvement. Their architecture uses continuous plausibility scoring + ranking (top M out of K candidates) rather than a hard pass/fail threshold. They also prompt the LLM to predict the expected co-movement sign, which can catch cases where the statistical (Granger/cointegration) sign is wrong. The existing staged prompt (2026-04-12 r29_sae_fire_prompt_update.json) uses a binary verdict with threshold>=40 — switching to ranking + sign prediction aligns with the validated architecture and should reduce large losers. The paper reports 205% total PnL improvement over pure statistical filtering.

changes_to_r29_llm_filter: 1. Remove hard binary verdict field. Replace with continuous plausibility_score (0-100) used for RANKING, not thresholding.
2. Add co_movement_sign field: LLM predicts whether pair should be positively or negatively correlated (+1/-1). Use this to VALIDATE or OVERRIDE the statistical cointegration sign.

3. Change pair selection logic: instead of 'keep all with score>=40', do 'rank all candidates by plausibility_score, keep top N' where N is configurable (suggest top 10-15 out of all candidate pairs).
4. Add mechanism_strength field: 'strong' / 'moderate' / 'weak' — can use as a secondary sort key.
5. If co_movement_sign disagrees with the statistical sign, either skip the pair or flip the trade direction.
implementation_notes.selection_logic: After scoring all candidate pairs, rank by plausibility_score DESC. Keep top N (suggest N=10-15). For any pair where co_movement_sign != stat_sign: either skip (conservative) or flip trade direction (aggressive). Start with skip for safety.
implementation_notes.key_paper_result: Kim et al. 2026: Granger top-100 → LLM re-rank → trade top-20. Win rate: 51.4%→54.5%. Avg loss: -$649→-$347 (46.5% reduction). Total PnL: +205%. Best hold period: 1d (WR 66.7%). Effect robust across GPT-5-nano and GPT-5-mini.
